title: Morgan and Townsend Brown's conversation about a time travel list
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Morgan and Townsend Brown's conversation about a time travel list, about unknown at Morgan's office, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, that recalls a conversation between Morgan and Townsend Brown, where Morgan's in his office and Townsend Brown said, "What if What if we had the ability to time travel? You know, I believe we're going to be able to do it in our lifetime."

plain: In a documentary about Townsend Brown, a scientist he presents as having worked for the CIA and having built UFO-like craft, podcast host Jesse Michels tells of a conversation in the office of a man named Morgan. According to Michels, Brown asked Morgan, "What if we had the ability to time travel?" and said he believed they would be able to do it in their lifetime. In his telling, this shows how far Brown thought his research could go.
